summary: The economic-time-series-analysis skill already covers the core capability demonstrated in this trace. The trace shows successful execution with one key learning: the agent initially missed averaging all three 2025 quarters for advertising data, only capturing Q1. This pattern of partial quarterly data capture is a reusable anti-pattern to document. The fix was explicitly detecting and averaging all quarterly rows (Q1, Q2, Q3) when they appear in annual data. I will update the existing skill to add this specific anti-pattern and improve the quarterly data handling documentation.
